auth.description:
VoIPstudio API Key

**Web Dashboard - Add API Key**

Follow steps below to add API Key for a user:

1. In Administration panel edit user for whom API Keys needs to be added.
2. Go to API Keys section.
3. Enter a name for your API Key, this can be anything you like. For example a name of your application that will use this API Key.
4. Click "Add" button.
5. Click "Eye" icon to retrieve the actual API Key

transfer_list.description: Whether to add to transfer list

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new contact in the VoIPstudio address book, capturing name, company, email, multiple phone/mobile/speed-dial numbers, labels, groups, and notes. All fields are optional, so pass whatever identifying details are available. Not idempotent: each call adds another contact record, so re-running with the same input produces duplicates.

makeACallToLead.name: makeACallToLead
makeACallToLead.description: Make a leadcall from user to e164 number

to.description: Destination number in e164 format or extension

aiMetadata.description: Places an outbound lead call to a destination number (E.164 or extension) and plays a text-to-speech message; all three inputs (caller ID, destination, TTS text) are required. Choose this for automated outreach calls that announce a spoken message rather than connecting two people. Not idempotent: each call initiates a new phone call.

makeACall.name: makeACall
makeACall.description: Make a call to a number in e164 format

from.description: User ID from which call should originate

caller_id.description: Caller ID to use for the call. E164 number or 'anonymous'

aiMetadata.description: Initiates an outbound call to a destination number in E.164 format; only the destination is required, while the originating user ID and caller ID (an E.164 number or 'anonymous') are optional. Use this to place a standard phone call from a VoIPstudio user. Not idempotent: each call starts a new call.

makeAWebcall.name: makeAWebcall
makeAWebcall.description: Make a webcall from e164 number to other e164 number or extension

to.description: Destination number in e164 format or extension

aiMetadata.description: Initiates a webcall that bridges a source number to a destination number or extension; both the source (E.164) and destination (E.164 or extension) are required. Use this to connect two parties by calling the source first, then the destination. Not idempotent: each call starts a new call.

Sends an SMS text message to a destination number in E.164 format; the destination and message text are required, while the sender number is optional. Use this for outbound text notifications. Not idempotent: each call sends a new message.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

callConnected.name: callConnected
callConnected.description: Triggered when a call is connected

instruction.description:
1. Login to https://voipstudio.com/
2. Click on **Integrations**
3. Scroll down to **Webhooks** and Enable
4. Select **Add Webhook** to create a new one
5. Enter any name for the new Webhook to identify
6. Select events to listen for. Select **Call Connected** event
7. Enter the following URL in the webhook configuration
	```text
			{{webhookUrl}}
			```

aiMetadata.description: Fires the moment a VoIPstudio call is answered and the two parties become connected, representing the start of an active conversation. Requires the Call Connected webhook event to be enabled in the VoIPstudio integrations panel.

callEnded.name: callEnded
callEnded.description: Triggered when a call ends or is terminated

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a VoIPstudio call hangs up or is otherwise terminated, representing the completion of a call along with its duration and termination cause. Requires the Call Ended webhook event to be enabled in the VoIPstudio integrations panel.

callTracking.name: callTracking
callTracking.description: Triggers when call associated with Call Tracking campaign visits is finished.

aiMetadata.description: Fires when a call tied to a Call Tracking campaign finishes, representing a completed tracked call with its billing, duration, and source/destination details. Polls the VoIPstudio call tracking campaigns endpoint and emits each newly completed call since the last check.

Requires the DTMF Received webhook event to be enabled in the VoIPstudio integrations panel.

VoIPstudio API-Schlüssel

**Web-Dashboard - API-Schlüssel**

Folgen Sie den Schritten unten, um einen API-Schlüssel für einen Benutzer hinzuzufügen:

1. Im Verwaltungspanel Benutzer bearbeiten, für den API-Schlüssel hinzugefügt werden müssen.

3. Geben Sie einen Namen für Ihren API-Schlüssel ein, das kann alles sein, was Ihnen gefällt. Zum Beispiel ein Name Ihrer Anwendung, der diesen API-Schlüssel verwendet.
4. Klicken Sie auf "Hinzufügen" Button.
5. Klicken Sie auf "Auge" um den aktuellen API-Schlüssel zu erhalten
